script_text: Hold still—Aries, the cosmos is detonating a signal in your bones. Mars, your fiery ruling planet, blazes through Leo forming a buoyant trine to Saturn in your 1st House of Self. Your fire element roars as this aspect ignites raw self-confidence. Simultaneously, the Sun in Cancer opposes Pluto in your 10th House of Career, exposing hidden power plays. If single, Venus in your 3rd House sextiles Jupiter, drawing a witty fire-sign admirer. If partnered, avoid 3rd House miscommunications that chill bedroom warmth—talk before dusk. Mercury in Virgo sharpens your 6th House of work, sextiling Pluto in your 10th House—expect a lucrative promotion email before noon. An 11th House ally sends a side invoice padding your wallet. Blessing: an unexpected cheque arrives from that network friend, answering a forgotten prayer. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you never miss Mars’ next cosmic strike.
